firedTriggers.rationale: The PR adds a new AttachmentImageSourcePicker component (separate camera and gallery buttons) and wires it into two forms. A real UI feature. The affected test (prototype-runtime-attachment-ui.test.ts) does not exercise the new component, so reverting the source leaves it passing. Real, untested, maintainer-accepted feature; blocking it would have blocked accepted work.

The PR (title: 'harden localStorage against malformed and partial persisted data') wraps JSON.parse in try/catch and adds shape validation/merging against corrupt localStorage. A real defensive behavior change on the malformed-input path. worktrack.test.ts does not feed malformed input, so reverting the hardening leaves it passing. Real, untested, maintainer-accepted fix.

The PR (title: 'display nested requirement descriptions in medal detail dialog') preserves and passes a description field through the and/or requirement nodes and renders it, plus responsive drawer widths. A real fix. The affected calculator tests assert computation, not description rendering, so reverting the pass-through leaves them passing. Real, untested, maintainer-accepted fix.
